caption_L1: This is a bar diagram called Annual number of registered crimes in Belgium from 2009 to the 1st semester of 2019. A categorical scale starting with 2009 and ending with 2019* can be seen on the y-axis, marked Year. There is a linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 1,000,000 along the x-axis, marked Number of registered crimes.
caption_L2L3: The number of registered crimes showed small, steady increases from 2009 - 2011, then decreased at a similar steady rate to 2017 and remained stable in 2018. 2019 saw a large drop in the number of registered crimes, to half the amount of the previous year.
